article.title: Сальмонелла в дынях: как результаты прошлых проб ускорили расследование
article.scope: Полный перевод основной статьи на 2 журнальных страницах: все 4 абзаца расследования, блок краткого содержания из трёх вопросов и ответов, 1 рисунок с подписью, сведения об авторах и организациях, данные для переписки, заявление о конфликте интересов и обе сноски. Все 3 библиографические записи сохранены на языке оригинала. График воспроизведён без изменения данных; перевод надписей приведён под ним. Текст, PDF и рисунок получены из PubMed Central; текст сверен с журнальным PDF. Редакционные пояснения отделены от перевода.

source.license: Public domain explicitly stated in article-specific PMC XML; CC0 license reference.
source.rights_note: Attribution, free-source link, translation/change notice and nonendorsement supplied. Journal PDF and original figure from official PMC mirror preserved byte-for-byte. Figure labels translated separately; figure also embedded in both offline HTML files.
source.status_check: No correction found in targeted DOI/PubMed search. Crossref has no update-to; XML has no retraction relation.
source.retrieval: Direct local HTTPS timed out; VPS and Russian VPS returned 403 for CDC assets. Official PMC open-data mirror provided complete XML, unchanged journal PDF and original figure. Source references checked directly against PDF.

selection.reader: Food safety, HACCP, laboratory, fresh-produce quality and purchasing professionals
selection.utility: Reusing environmental isolate data across years; advance interview preparation; limits of faster investigation for short-season produce.
selection.limits: Historical investigation, not a current recall. Environmental strain not linked to illnesses in the 2020 outbreak; initial seven-allele and case-definition ten-allele thresholds separate. 36/47 is interviewed patients, not all 87. Healthy comparator is historical. Source was probable; comparison of two investigations is not a controlled causal test. Identification remained after growing season; no recall or prevented cases claimed.

review.numeric_literals: pass; English thousands separators and Russian grouping spaces normalized separately from decimal commas
review.arithmetic: 36/47 rounds to 77%; 32/87 rounds to 37%; state counts sum to 87 across 11 states. Aug 4 to Aug 25 = 21 days; Sep 18 to Oct 23 = 35 days; reduction 14 days = 2 weeks. Healthy comparison survey denominator absent, so p-value not independently reconstructed.
review.spelled_numbers: Initial 12 isolates related within seven allele differences distinguished from final case definition within 10. Thirty-two admissions and all spelled state counts preserved. Median 65, range 1–93, 67% female preserved without inferring numerator.
review.pdf_visual_review: All five pages inspected. Editorial context, full translation, chart with translated legend, author details, footnotes, references and attribution legible. Both original journal pages also inspected.

typesafe.mode: Additional qualification review; full manual source comparison retained, no efficiency claim.
typesafe.manual_review: All four accepted pairs and negative control reviewed. Source explicitly excludes the 2020 environmental strain from that year's outbreak; seven and ten allele thresholds retained; 36/47 versus historical 29% comparator and probable source retained; harvest ended before action and future benefit remains conditional. A repeated 2020 date was expanded after the advisory check solely to match source numeric occurrences; final literal and full-source checks pass.

review.figure_legend_review: Historical infections includes a dark bar in early 2022 outside the 2022 outbreak. Russian legend and alt text use ранее зарегистрированные случаи, not a previous-years restriction. Original figure bytes remain unchanged.
